successors.name: East India Company
successors.text: Sambalpur State lapsed to the British

ledger.x: 1570: Balarama Deva receives the northern side of the Ang River when Patna State is split; the Chauhan kingdom of Sambalpur (Hirakhand) begins.
1849: the British annex Sambalpur by the doctrine of lapse on the death of Narayan Singh without a male heir.
1849: the state ends; placed in the Cuttack division of Bengal in 1858 and the Central Provinces in 1862.

certainty.note: No boundary on the page; core districts only.
